description: Shared Renovate preset for rysk-tanaka repositories

packageRules.description: Callers pin these reusable workflows to a main commit SHA, so updates arrive as digest updates that the minor/patch rule does not cover. Digests of a branch carry no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge would keep renovate/stability-days pending forever

customManagers.description: Track the commit SHA that pins this preset in extends. Without a pin, Renovate reads default.json from main on every run, so a rewritten main would change every repository's config before the schedule allows it
